evidencePolicy.summary: Explicit field allowlist; evidence is reduced from the recorded required checks and reviewed synthetic outcomes. Raw responses, logs, provider objects and generated sign-in identifiers are omitted.
evidencePolicy.fixtureIdentity: All prompts and account identities in these cases are synthetic.
evidencePolicy.rawArtifacts: Raw local attempts are not included. Their SHA256 hashes identify the retained originals.
evidencePolicy.timestamps: The harness records run start, report output, attempt output and duration; individual attempt start times are not separately recorded.
evidencePolicy.limits: Synthetic connection and reconnect cases stop at owned pending consent. This does not verify live OAuth completion, grant renewal, packaged setup or real-account delivery.
